concerns.text: FR-001 states that the system MUST collect human‑annotated feasibility scores for **all 1000 prompts** via crowd‑sourcing (see FR‑009), while FR-009 only requires collection for **at least 200 prompts**. This creates a direct contradiction about the required annotation coverage, making the paired statistical tests (FR‑005, SC‑001, etc.) under‑specified and potentially under‑powered.
